'''Calico Falls''' is a piece of [[furniture]] that hangs on a wall. It can rotate into daily stock at the [[Carpenter's Shop]] for {{Price|750}} or the [[Traveling Cart]] for between {{Tprice|furniture}}.

It's also available from the [[Furniture Catalogue]] for {{Price|0}}.

Calico Falls is used as the icon for the [[Bundles#Specialty Fish Bundle|Specialty Fish Bundle]] in the [[Bundles#Fish Tank|Fish Tank]] inside the [[Community Center]].
